products.name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Lost & Found'
products.description: The classic 1985 silhouette returns with vintage distressing, aged pre-yellowed midsoles, cracked leather collars, and an authentic vintage receipt in the box. Authenticity guaranteed with double-boxed air freight to Accra.

products.name: Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low OG 'Reverse Mocha'
products.description: Iconic oversized reverse Swoosh with premium mocha nubuck, crisp sail leather overlays, and custom Cactus Jack embroidered heel insignias. Highly sought-after pre-order exclusive.

products.name: Adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Onyx'
products.description: Monochrome stealth aesthetic with Primeknit re-engineered upper, post-dyed monofilament side stripe, and full-length encapsulated Boost sole unit for unmatched all-day comfort.

products.name: New Balance 9060 'Rain Cloud Grey'
products.description: Futuristic Y2K chunky runner silhouette featuring sway bars taken from the 990, dual-density ABZORB and SBS cushioning, and a sculptured pod midsole.

products.name: Nike Dunk Low Retro 'White Black / Panda'
products.description: The timeless clean contrast two-tone staple. Smooth leather upper with padded nylon tongue and durable rubber traction outsole.

products.name: Rolex Submariner Date 41mm Oystersteel
products.description: The archetypal divers' watch. Unidirectional Cerachrom bezel in black ceramic, luminous Chromalight display, caliber 3235 automatic movement with 70-hour power reserve. Full original box and papers.

products.name: Cartier Santos de Cartier Medium Model
products.description: Historic aviator watch with steel case, 7-sided crown set with a faceted synthetic spinel, blued-steel sword-shaped hands, and SmartLink sizing system with QuickSwitch interchangeable leather strap.

products.name: Omega Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch Co-Axial
products.description: The Moonwatch certified by NASA. Master Chronometer Calibre 3861 with hesanite crystal, dot over ninety bezel detail, and 50-hour power reserve.

products.name: Prada Re-Nylon Bomber Jacket Oversized
products.description: Voluminous couture proportions crafted in regenerative Re-Nylon with signature enameled metal triangle logo on the utility sleeve pocket, ribbed knit trims, and padded interior.

products.name: Balenciaga Track 3 Sneaker Double Laces
products.description: Multifaceted high-tech layered cage mesh and nylon sneaker with articulated chunky sole, printed sizing at toe edge, and embossed Track logo on the heel counter.

products.name: Dior B23 High-Top Sneaker Dior Oblique
products.description: Crafted in clear transparent mesh over Dior Oblique motif fabric, contrast white rubber sole with DIOR signature insert, and reinforced back pull tab.

products.name: Louis Vuitton Monogram Keepall Bandoulière 50
products.description: The timeless cabin luggage bag in durable coated Monogram Eclipse canvas. Smooth cowhide leather trimmings, removable shoulder strap, padlock with keys and leather name tag.

products.name: Chrome Hearts Cross Patch Denim Vintage Blue
colors: Vintage Indigo / Black Leather Cross Patches
products.description: Reconstructed vintage Levi's 501 base with hand-stitched leather cemetery cross patches, 925 sterling silver hardware buttons and scroll rivet accents on back pocket.

products.name: Gallery Dept. 5001 Repurposed Flare Denim
products.description: Handmade flared cut created by opening the outer seam and inserting raw denim triangles. Features unique paint splatters and vintage faded wash.

products.name: Purple Brand P001 Distressed Raw Black
products.description: Heavyweight premium cotton denim with 2% elastane for comfort, blowouts with inner fabric backing, hidden rivets, and signature Purple Brand hanging hangtag.

products.name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait
products.description: The peak of luxury niche perfumery. Notes of Grandiflorum jasmine from Egypt, bitter almond from Morocco, ambergris and woody cedar accord.

products.name: Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum 100ml
products.description: Celebrated masculine icon. Crisp opening of bergamot, blackcurrant leaves, and pineapple, developing into smoky birch, jasmine, patchouli, and oakmoss.

products.name: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
products.description: Opulent and warm artisanal scent featuring rich tobacco leaf, aromatic spices, creamy vanilla, cocoa, dry fruit accords, and sweet wood sap.

products.name: Kilian Angels' Share Eau de Parfum
products.description: Inherited from the Hennessy cognac lineage: infused with essence of cognac, cinnamon essence, tonka bean absolute, oak moss, and warm praline.

products.name: Van Cleef & Arpels Vintage Alhambra 5 Motifs Bracelet
products.description: Faithful to the 1968 design. Five cloverleaf motifs edged with golden beads in 18K yellow gold set with polished genuine Onyx gemstones. Hallmarked with certificate of authenticity.

products.name: Cartier Love Bracelet 18K Yellow Gold
products.description: Conceived in 1969 New York. Oval silhouette that sits tightly on the wrist, fastened using an ergonomic screwdriver included in the original red presentation box.

products.name: Moissanite VVS Iced-Out Cuban Link Chain (14mm)
products.description: Solid 925 sterling silver prong-set with GRA-certified VVS1 D-Color brilliant round cut Moissanites that pass thermal diamond testers. Triple-locking box clasp.

products.name: Tiffany & Co. HardWear Graduated Link Necklace
products.description: Inspired by a 1971 archival bracelet. Bold industrial gauge links arranged in a graduated scale for a striking ergonomic contour around the collarbone.

products.name: Chanel Classic 11.12 Flap Bag Medium Lambskin
products.description: The crown jewel of handbag design. Supple diamond-quilted lambskin, signature leather-interlaced gold chain strap, and double CC turnstile clasp.

products.name: Goyard Saint Louis PM Tote Bag
products.description: Ultralight, reversible, waterproof Goyardine chevron canvas with sturdy Chevroches calfskin handles. Includes attached interior matching envelope coin pouch.

products.name: Bottega Veneta Padded Cassette Crossbody
products.description: Orthogonal maxi-weave intreccio technique in pillow-padded paper calf leather with triangular buckle shoulder strap and magnetic closure.

products.name: Rimowa Original Cabin Aluminum Suitcase
products.description: Engineered in Germany with robust grooved high-end aluminum, TSA-approved locks, Multiwheel ball-bearing system, and height-adjustable Flex Divider.

products.name: Gentle Monster Her 01 Oversized Sunglasses
colors: Glossy Black / 100% UV Zeiss Black Lenses
products.description: Bold square oversized silhouette with subtle rounded edges, bullet-shaped metal pins at temple corners, and 99.9% UV protection Zeiss nylon lenses.

products.name: Dior Oblique Jacquard Card Holder
products.description: Streamlined modern luxury essential. Two slots on each side with central receipt compartment, trimmed with premium black calfskin leather and brass DIOR signature.

products.name: Chrome Hearts CH Hollywood Trucker Hat
products.description: Cult-favorite trucker cap with embroidered CH Hollywood horseshoe patch, breathable rear mesh, and .925 sterling silver top scroll button.
